name: claude-state
description: Installs Nix and the claude-state CLI, and wires up reconstruct-on-create / verify-on-start. Holds no policy of its own — every rule lives in the classification manifest inside the flake this feature fetches.

flakeRef.description: Flake reference to fetch claude-state from.

resticRepository.description: Value exported as RESTIC_REPOSITORY. A path under /workspaces survives container rebuild but not environment deletion — see the project README for what that limitation means.

claudeConfigDir.description: Value exported as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR — the directory claude-state manages.
